author: FazeOfKnight1
body:
Okay, most of y'all gonna be like: oh ew, he's sucking up. But no actually; this server has one of the best staff around. ./report actually works, bam, a mod comes along. The mods are spread out evenly across gamemodes and timezones. Reports are dealt with fast- web or in game. For example: today I encountered around 4 hackers. Credits to Theo and yoav for coming along straightaway and banning them.
Okay; straight from my heart; thanks a lot for the hard work and time.
